class.name: HTMLSubmitEvent
class.description: [code]submit[/code] runs after constraint validation passes and before the entries are collected. Cancelling it aborts the submission, so [signal HTMLLabel.form_submitted] is not emitted. [code]reset[/code] runs only for a reset button; calling [method HTMLFormElement.reset] from a script does not dispatch it.

members.member: The button that initiated the submission, or [code]null[/code] for a programmatic submit or a reset.
